Welcome To Trim Castle Hotel
Welcome to Trim Castle Hotel, where rich history and contemporary elegance come together in the heart of the Boyne Valley, overlooking the magnificent Trim Castle . Set against one of Ireland’s most iconic landmarks, our hotel offers a unique blend of heritage, comfort, and modern luxury.
Discover our new Rooftop Thermal Experience — a thoughtfully designed wellness journey of heat, water, and deep relaxation. From soothing warmth to revitalising cool therapies, it’s the perfect space to unwind, recharge, and take in stunning views of the surrounding landscape.
Whether you’re planning a peaceful getaway, a romantic escape, or a well-deserved break, Trim Castle Hotel provides the perfect setting. Relax in beautifully appointed rooms, wake to hearty, freshly prepared breakfasts, and enjoy genuine, attentive hospitality throughout your stay.

Location
County Meath, known as the Royal County, was once the territory of the High Kings of Ireland. Trim is one of Meath s most significant heritage county towns and has something to offer everyone. Boasting the largest and most impressive Norman Castle in Ireland, visitors can stay at Trim Castle Hotel and experience the magic of must-see attractions on the trial of Ireland s Ancient East.
Trim Castle Hotel is located 40 minutes from Dublin Airport and 50 minutes from Dublin City Centre. A Bus Eireann coach service runs between Trim and Dublin regularly and stops a short distance from our hotel. We also provide airport taxi transfers please contact us for more information.
Our Sat Nav Co-Ordinates are N 53.55359, W 6.79214

Signature Thermal Stays
Set within the heart of the Boyne Valley, a thermal stay at Trim Castle Hotel invites you to slow the pace, allowing warmth, water and stillness to restore balance.
Note- Guests can avail Free Parking at the Hotel for Day Thermal Experiences and Overnight Getaways.
Relax and unwind with two hours in the Rooftop Thermal Experience overlooking Trim Castle. Move between the hydrotherapy pool, Jacuzzi, sauna and cold plunge designed to revitalise body and mind.
Take time to pause in the relaxation area and absorb the peaceful atmosphere high above the historic town of Trim.

Experience the ultimate in comfort and luxury with our classically designed guest rooms at Trim Castle Hotel. Unwind and relax in a warm and inviting atmosphere with natural light bathing the space and warm neutral tones creating a welcoming ambience – you’ll feel right at home. Whether you stay in our Heritage Guest room with stunning views of Trim Castle, or a spacious Family room complete with a Tepee tent, we have the perfect accommodation to ensure a memorable stay.
